title: Democrats withdraw endorsements of Eric Swalwell and demand he end bid for California governor
notes: Chosen from New Gray's ranked list of three reports of the withdrawals (CNN, the AP's story in News4JAX's copy, Reuters) as the first that Wayback holds and that passes the read-only check; the other two were not read. A located copy: the capture, of 03:04:13 UTC on 2026-04-11, prints By Eric Bradner, PUBLISHED Apr 10, 2026, 7:25 PM ET (23:25 UTC), Updated 10:31 PM ET (02:31 UTC on 2026-04-11). It reports that "California Sen. Adam Schiff and Arizona Sen. Ruben Gallego, both longtime allies, said they were withdrawing their endorsements" and that House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries "called on him to drop out", on Friday, 2026-04-10.
